description: Canonical Strand API surface. Every consumer type must implement this surface. The parity test reads this file and asserts conformance. Adding a primitive is a PR that updates this file AND adds the primitive to every consumer type in the same release. Removing a primitive requires a major version bump.

cssOnlyComponents.name: AuthIndicator
cssOnlyComponents.reason: Signed-in indicator with avatar; a consumer composes the markup.

cssOnlyComponents.name: Banner
cssOnlyComponents.reason: Its consumer injects the markup server-side (an HTMLRewriter writing .strand-banner before first paint) and never mounts a component, so the classes are the whole API.

cssOnlyComponents.name: BarChart
cssOnlyComponents.reason: Bars are data-driven markup a consumer emits.

cssOnlyComponents.name: ChannelGrid
cssOnlyComponents.reason: Channel index grid; a consumer emits the cards.

cssOnlyComponents.name: Chip
cssOnlyComponents.reason: Filter chip; consumers render it inside their own controls.

cssOnlyComponents.name: ClusterMarker

cssOnlyComponents.name: CoordReadout

cssOnlyComponents.name: DetailPanel

cssOnlyComponents.name: EmptyState

Banner.note: Banner component exists in strand-ui but not in strand-svelte or strand-vue. Excluded from the parity manifest until Banner is added to all three framework libraries. Adding it is a parity-raising task in a future session.

notes: This manifest is the MVP parity contract. Extension to track prop shapes, CSS class names, and tokens is future work. The current contract asserts: (1) every component name here exists as a directory in every framework package's components folder, (2) every publishable package has the same version number.
foreignBlocksNote: Blocks a component stylesheet defines that are neither its own name, nor rendered by its component, nor declared under cssOnlyComponents. Recorded so the exception is legible and cannot grow silently; every entry carries its reason here. InstrumentViewport defines .strand-body--instrument, the page-scale form of the same dark surface: one token set, two scopes. Nav defines the body classes .strand-glass-nav-active and .strand-banner-active, which the vanilla runtime toggles for browsers without :has() so the fixed nav can reserve its height.
darkCabinetComponentsNote: The dark instrument cabinet (DL 9.3). Text in these components is painted on the abyss, never on a light surface, so contrast-check judges them against the dark surface. Membership is a decision, so it is declared rather than inferred from a file boundary; the instrument furniture (search bar, map pins, cluster marker, coordinate readout, scanline, vignette) joined when it moved out of InstrumentViewport.css into its own directories. Add a component here only if its text genuinely never appears on a light surface. DetailPanel is a light island and stays out.
